from fractions import Fraction

def simplify(x: str, n: str) -> bool:
    """
    Return True if the two fraction strings represent the same rational number,
    otherwise return False.
    """
    frac1 = Fraction(*map(int, x.split("/")))
    frac2 = Fraction(*map(int, n.split("/")))
    return frac1 == frac2
